version_assignment: Day-60 target date and publishing schedule, not the 91-day window field; daily archive headers not rechecked here
cut_rule: zero-based floor(N*fraction) of target-date-sorted eligible original-training CVEs; ties stay together
selection_rule: latest 20 percent by target date among earlier candidates after assessment-component exclusion; ties stay together
component_policy: reuse complete CT05 original-training exact-document components, including paths through excluded versions and accepted D/M/G/N documents; URLs alone do not link CVEs
purge_policy: retain all assessment CVEs; exclude earlier candidates sharing an assessment component; retain selection CVEs; exclude optimization candidates sharing a selection component
empty_or_weak_fold_policy: report unchanged; never move dates, drop folds, lower thresholds or unlock training automatically
support_interpretation: operational review triggers, not power calculations; failures never alter role allocation

future_comparison.D: standalone D token mean; D-only source flags
future_comparison.DF: the same standalone D token mean as D; DM source flags, but no post text
future_comparison.DM: combined D+accepted M token mean; DM source flags; no G/N input
future_comparison.structured: identical CVSS/reference allowlist in all arms, fitted independently on each optimization role; never reuse full-training-fitted transformations
future_comparison.precomputed: reuse hash-verified frozen SecureBERT D/DM token means only; no GNN, new graph or embedding training
future_comparison.primary_contrast: Reddit-v2 DM minus D pooled OOF RMSE, mean of seed-wise differences
future_comparison.ridge: A wider penalty grid needs a separate versioned specification; no ridge search is enabled here
future_comparison.shuffle: seed*1000003 + fold*1009 + epoch; same order across matched arms
future_comparison.selection: earliest strict best selection RMSE; no assessment-based selection and no refit
future_comparison.checkpoint_retention: best checkpoint only per fit, with optimizer/RNG state for deterministic resume
future_comparison.interpretation: New exploratory retrospective within-version study on previously inspected training records; not independent confirmation or historically verified forecasting
